title: "Topic: Intellectual Property"
---

*Use at baseline and endline. Captures how firms protect the results of their innovation activities.*

---

*(Select all that apply)*
- Patent
- Industrial design right
- Trademark
- Copyright
- Trade secrets
- None of the above

**For each selected: How many?**
*(Open numeric field)*

**During the last three years, did your company:**
*(Select all that apply)*
- Apply for a patent 
- Register an industrial design right 
- Register a trademark
- Registered designs
- Claim a copyright
- Use trade secrets
- None of the above

**For each selected: How many?**
*(Open numeric field)*

**If "None of the above" was selected for both questions: Why does your firm not have any IP and has not applied for it recently?**
- Do not have an innovation (product, process) for it
- Do not know how to apply for it 
- Do not have the resources to apply for it
- Previous applications have been rejected
- Not a priority
- Other (please specify)

**10.2 During the last three years, did your company use any of the following informal methods to protect innovations or competitive advantages?**
*(Select all that apply)*
- Secrecy or confidential agreements (NDAs)
- Complexity of design (making the product difficult to copy)
- Lead time advantage (being first to market)
- None

*Source: CIS. Use at: Baseline and endline.*

**10.3 How important are the following as reasons for protecting your intellectual property?**
*Rate each: 1 = Not relevant, 2 = Low, 3 = Medium, 4 = High*
- To prevent competitors from copying our products or processes
- To support licensing agreements or technology transfer
- To attract investors or financing
- To strengthen our market position

*Source: CIS / OECD Oslo Manual. Use at: Baseline and endline.*

- Yes
- No

**10.6 What were the main barriers to protecting your intellectual property?**
*(Select all that apply)*
- High cost of filing and maintaining IP protection
- Complexity of the IP system
- Lack of knowledge about IP protection options
- Difficulty enforcing IP rights
- No barriers — we protect our IP as needed

*Source: CIS / European IPO survey. Use at: Baseline.*
